description: Finish plan Tasks 1-6 (per-feed limit, URL rules, non-incident filter, strict agent contract, heuristic removal, preflight + mandatory-agent CLI). Production code for these tasks is ALREADY in the working tree (see context.json key_patterns); verify it against the requirements, fix gaps, finish dependency/geolocate cleanup, and write the test suite. Leaves pytest fully green except for nothing (handler.py is fixed in FEAT-003 but has no test importing it).
steps: Review pipeline/sources.py, models.py, agent_extract.py, extract.py, transform.py, cli.py against requirements R1-R7, R9-R11 of the user plan. Fix only real gaps; do not rewrite working code. In particular confirm: `_NON_ARTICLE_SEGMENTS` includes sounds, podcast, podcasts, video, videos, live, audio, newsletter, newsletters, webinar, webinars and is checked on every path segment while the existing last-segment rule stays; `is_reportable_incident` is called in `_emit` and NOT in `load_curated`; `StrikeDossier` has every field required except nullable `origin_country`; the system prompt states the R6 country rule order (country stated in report -> victim org HQ -> vulnerable product vendor HQ -> most-affected country; never attacker origin or outlet country); `norm_country` rejects ZZ, XX and codes missing from geolocate.COUNTRY_CENTROIDS; R7 normalization is lowercase + collapsed whitespace + stripped trailing punctuation, equal or impact == first sentence of summary; curated impact never replaced.
pyproject.toml: move `strands-agents>=1`, `pydantic>=2`, `boto3>=1.34` into `[project] dependencies` (keep defusedxml), delete the `agent` optional extra and its comment.

pipeline/requirements.txt: rewrite comments so strands-agents/pydantic/boto3 are described as REQUIRED (mandatory extraction agent; still imported lazily so `import pipeline.agent_extract` succeeds without them). Remove the 'optional' and 'USE_AGENT=1' wording and the claim that the pipeline runs offline with only stdlib + defusedxml.

pipeline/geolocate.py: grep the whole repo (excluding .venv/node_modules) for resolve_country, COUNTRY_NAMES, COUNTRY_ALIASES, _AMBIGUOUS_NAMES, _build_name_index and the name regex. If only tests use them, remove them from geolocate.py and update the module docstring; keep COUNTRY_CENTROIDS, country_display, _jitter, Geolocator, _load_countries.

pipeline/tests/test_geolocate.py: delete the resolve_country / ambiguous-name / longer-name tests and their imports; keep the CSV coverage, binary compatibility, display round-trip, jitter, Null Island fallback and encode tests.

pipeline/tests/test_sources.py (Task 1, 2, 3): add (a) a test that monkeypatches `pipeline.sources._http_bytes` to return a synthetic RSS feed with 40 distinct reportable cyber-incident items with concrete article URLs and asserts fetch_all(offline=False) keeps 25 per feed by default and N when per_feed_limit=N (check the per-witness count); (b) `https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds/play/w3ct8jys` rejected by is_concrete_url, plus parametrized podcast/video/live/newsletter/webinar segment cases; (c) a regression asserting every URL in pipeline/fixtures/curated_incidents.json is accepted (keep/extend test_every_curated_incident_has_a_concrete_link); (d) a parametrized is_reportable_incident table: rejected = "Tech Life", three "The HackerNoon Newsletter: ..." titles, "Webinar: See How Identity Blind Spots Put Your SOC at Risk and How to Close Them", "Microsoft Says Outage Disrupting Outlook Is Improving", "What Is Web Cache Deception and How Can Attackers Exploit It?", "How Visual Programming Could Solve Three Major AI Cybersecurity Problems"; accepted = an Operation Endgame headline, SilentAir headlines (real titles are in /tmp/pool59.json if present; otherwise use realistic titles), and every curated title from the fixture with its summary; (e) a test that load_curated() returns all 7 curated rows even when is_reportable_incident is monkeypatched to always return False (proves load_curated does not filter), and that every row has curated=True; (f) a RawArticle.to_json/from_json round-trip test.

Rewrite pipeline/tests/test_agent_extract.py (Task 4, 6): remove tests for enrich/make_extractor/heuristic. Use a stub agent object whose structured_output(model, prompt) returns a SimpleNamespace dossier (inject via StrandsExtractor's existing injection point, read the constructor). Cover: valid dossier -> correct mapping (uppercased country, lowercase severity, origin None when null/ZZ); country 'ZZ', 'XX', nonexistent code like 'QQ', empty text field, attack_type 'unknown' or not in ATTACK_TYPES, bad severity -> DossierValidationError; impact == summary and impact == first sentence of summary (with case/whitespace/punctuation differences) -> 'Impact not disclosed.'; stub agent raising -> extract raises (no swallowing); DEFAULT_MODEL_ID == 'us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8'; SEVERITY_LABELS mirror Severity enum; models.ATTACK_TYPES has no 'unknown'; pydantic schema test stays gated with pytest.mark.skipif(importlib.util.find_spec('pydantic') is None) and asserts origin_country nullable and other fields required. ensure_agent_ready with stub sts/bedrock clients: success for an inference-profile id (get_inference_profile called) and for a foundation model id (get_foundation_model called), returns resolved model id; sts raising (e.g. botocore NoCredentialsError or a generic Exception) -> AgentUnavailable; bedrock raising model-not-found -> AgentUnavailable; required_modules containing a nonexistent module -> AgentUnavailable.

Rewrite pipeline/tests/test_pipeline.py (Task 5, 6): delete heuristic tests (classify_attack, classify_severity, detect_data/origin, resolve_country, bbc heuristic). Keep/adapt within_window, recency filter and RECENCY_WINDOW_DAYS==90 tests. Add with a counting stub extractor (object with extract(article)->dict and a calls counter, can be configured to fail for specific titles): precedence (curated override values win over stub values field by field), skip guard (fully curated article -> zero extract calls), partial curated row -> agent fills only blanks, single failure -> article discarded and report built, abort with 3/10 failures -> ReportAborted(discarded=3,total=10), no abort with 2/10, ids contiguous 1..n after a discard, offline run via transform.run(offline=True, report_date=date(2026,11,14), ready_check=stub, extractor=stub) makes ZERO stub calls and yields the curated strikes inside the window (SolarWinds 2020-12-13 dropped), build_report(extractor=None) raises TypeError, finalize_dossier raises on missing/invalid fields, R7 dedupe not applied when impact is curated. CLI: cli.main(['--out', tmp, '--offline'], ready_check=<raises AgentUnavailable>) returns 2 and a monkeypatched pipeline.transform.fetch_all is never called; ReportAborted path returns 3; success path writes snapshot.json + snapshot.bin; --per-feed-limit value is forwarded to fetch_all; parser has no --use-agent (passing it exits with SystemExit 2 from argparse).

Snapshot reproducibility test: run transform.run offline at 2026-11-14 with stub ready_check/extractor, encode with binary.encode and compare bytes to frontend/public/snapshots/latest/snapshot.bin; compare report.to_json() to the committed snapshot.json ignoring generated_at. If they differ, do NOT regenerate committed fixtures in this feature; record the diff in findings.
Run ruff --fix only if needed, then black on changed files; full test suite and lint must be green.
acceptance_criteria: .venv/bin/python -m pytest pipeline/tests -q passes with zero errors/failures
No test references attribute_origin, classify_*, make_extractor, enrich, resolve_country, use_agent
pyproject.toml has no [project.optional-dependencies].agent and lists strands-agents, pydantic, boto3 in dependencies
CLI with a failing preflight returns 2 without calling fetch_all (asserted by test)
Offline run with complete curated rows makes zero extractor calls (asserted by test)
ruff check and black --check are clean for pipeline/
findings: 132 tests green; ruff + black clean. Gap fixed in sources.py: _CYBER_KEYWORDS lacked 'hijack', 'implant', 'exfiltrat', so the SilentAir headline and the curated Trezor row were rejected by is_reportable_incident; added those three keywords. geolocate.py: resolve_country, COUNTRY_ALIASES, COUNTRY_NAMES, _AMBIGUOUS_NAMES, _build_name_index, _NAME_PATTERNS and the re import removed (only tests used them); docstring updated. StrandsExtractor stub injection is a callable agent: agent(prompt, structured_output_model=...) returning an object with .structured_output (not structured_output(model, prompt)). Snapshot reproducibility: offline stub run at 2026-11-14 matches committed snapshot.bin byte-for-byte and snapshot.json except generated_at, so no fixture regen needed (asserted by test_offline_run_reproduces_the_committed_snapshot). All 7 curated rows pin every required field (asserted by test_every_curated_row_is_fully_pinned); no curated rows needed completion, so nothing to present for review. black reformatted pipeline/transform.py (pre-existing baseline issue). /tmp/pool59.json was absent; realistic SilentAir/Endgame titles were used. handler.py untouched (FEAT-003). Nothing committed per orchestrator instruction.
